# Cncf Black Duck Reviewer

Review Black Duck using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Black Duck provides a comprehensive software composition analysis (SCA) solution for managing security, quality, and license compliance risk that comes from the use of open source and third-party code in applications and containers.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
